prompt:
Build a beautiful multi-page marketing website for "Agent Gitu", an open-source AI coding agent with a CLI, an Electron desktop app, and a browser-driven Cowork mode.

ART DIRECTION (a previous dark violet neon app-shell design was rejected, do NOT repeat it):
- LIGHT editorial / paper aesthetic: warm off-white background, near-black ink text, NO purple gradients, no neon, no dark hero.
- Technical, restrained, Swiss/editorial. Oversized headline, generous whitespace, hairline 1px rules, visible column grid, small-caps monospace eyebrow labels, numbered sections.
- One restrained accent color used sparingly; muted printed-manual feel.
- Self-contained: no external font CDNs, no frameworks, no build step. Plain static HTML + one CSS file + one JS file.

PAGES (separate files, one shared header nav: Home, Coding, Cowork, Docs, Blog, GitHub):
1. index.html - oversized hero headline + subhead, live-looking terminal mockup of an agent session, three-up feature grid, how-it-works sequence, footer CTA.
2. coding.html - CLI/IDE story: terminal blocks, keybindings, provider and model support, workflow steps.
3. cowork.html - browser Cowork mode: agent driving a real browser, screenshots, tool pipeline.
4. docs.html - sidebar table of contents with anchored sections, quickstart install commands, copy-to-clipboard button on code blocks, configuration reference table.
5. blog.html - article index as cards with title, date, read time, excerpt.
6. github.html - repo hero, stats, install commands, contribution steps.

MOTION: scroll-reveal via IntersectionObserver, hover lift on cards, animated terminal typing/caret, rule-draw on load, smooth anchor scrolling. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Mobile-first: hamburger nav panel under 860px, no horizontal overflow, responsive grids.

ACCESSIBILITY: semantic landmarks, labelled controls, visible focus rings, sufficient contrast, keyboard-navigable nav.

Build real working multi-page files, not a mockup or a description.
